request.state:
Subject: Re: sasl auth from home postfix to postfix server not working

On Mon, Feb 18, 2008 09:31:25 AM +0100, mouss wrote:

> you need to configure your home postfix to use STARTTLS
>    http://www.postfix.org/TLS_README.html#client_tls
>
> if you only want to test SASL without TLS to make sure it is
> working, set smtpd_tls_auth_only=no on the remote server. once this
> works, change the password and configure TLS on both sides.

With the configuration below, according to your suggestion, I get in the logs lines like:

  Feb 18 20:10:29 vps728 postfix/smtpd[32536]: connect from my.dynamic.hostname[my.home.ip.address]
  Feb 18 20:10:29 vps728 postfix/smtpd[32538]: connect from my.dynamic.hostname[my.home.ip.address]
  Feb 18 20:10:29 vps728 postfix/smtpd[32539]: connect from my.dynamic.hostname[my.home.ip.address]
  Feb 18 20:10:29 vps728 postfix/smtpd[32536]: disconnect from my.dynamic.hostname[my.home.ip.address]
  Feb 18 20:10:29 vps728 postfix/smtpd[32538]: disconnect from my.dynamic.hostname[my.home.ip.address]
  Feb 18 20:10:29 vps728 postfix/smtpd[32539]: disconnect from my.dynamic.hostname[my.home.ip.address]

That is, no more rejects, but nothing else either. There is no message
sent to the remote server.  This with:

# egrep 'sasl|tls' main.cf (remote server, running postfix 2.2)

broken_sasl_auth_clients             = yes
smtpd_sasl_auth_enable               = yes
smtpd_sasl_security_options          = noanonymous
smtpd_sasl_application_name          = smtpd
smtpd_sender_login_maps              = hash:/etc/postfix/sasl_senders
smtpd_tls_auth_only                  = no
smtpd_tls_key_file                   = /etc/mycert.pem
smtpd_tls_cert_file                  = /etc/mycert.pem
smtpd_tls_loglevel                   = 3
smtpd_recipient_restrictions         =  permit_sasl_authenticated,


# egrep 'sasl|tls' main.cf (local, home server, running postfix 2.4)  
smtp_sasl_auth_enable              = yes
smtp_sasl_password_maps            = hash:/etc/postfix/sasl_passwd
smtp_sasl_security_options         = noplaintext, noanonymous
smtp_sasl_tls_security_options     = $smtp_sasl_security_options
smtp_tls_security_level            = none
